title: Empanaditas de Cuajada (Curds Empanadillas)
description: Prepared with milk, eggs, and sugar.
steps: Proceed as for Puff Pastry Empanadas with Sugar and Wine
For the filling, curdle four small cups of milk
Squeeze the curds well
Mix with two egg whites and four egg yolks, four ounces of sugar, and a little butter
Beat until well incorporated
If the mixture is too thin and not consistent enough, add a little flour
Form small empanadillas
Fry in butter instead of baking in the oven

title: Empernada (Empernada)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, lard, and veal.
steps: Mix {{source-0}} with two egg yolks and knead strongly until the dough is smooth, adding a little lukewarm salted water
When well kneaded, roll out with a rolling pin and place about one tablespoon of filling on each empanada
Fold the dough and cut with a wheel, giving it the customary shape
Heat abundant lard until very hot and fry the empanadas until golden
For the filling, cut veal and pork into large pieces and cook with salt
When well cooked, chop fine until very ground and fry with tomato, onion, and garlic that have been well fried beforehand
When half fried, add a little vinegar and let dry until the meat turns very golden

title: Encebollado de Carne (Meat Stewed with Onions)
description: Prepared with beef or veal or mutton, butter or oil, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: broth from the pot or water
ingredients.sourceText: broth from the pot or water

ingredients.name: peeled potatoes or thick potato slices
ingredients.sourceText: peeled potatoes or thick potato slices

steps: Place a pot or pan over the heat with butter or oil; when hot, sauté the meat.
When well browned, add a little ground pepper, half a glass of vinegar, and cover with broth or water.
Add one whole clove, one tomato, one head of garlic, and one bay leaf.
If the meat is beef, being tougher, do not add the onion until it is half-cooked; but if it is veal or lamb, add plenty of onion right away, seasoning it.
When cooked, dissolve a little flour in cold water and add it to thicken the sauce and let it boil several times until the flour is dissolved.
Peeled potatoes or thick potato slices are often added as well.

title: Encrespados Franceses (French Crêpes)
description: Prepared with brandy, orange, and lard or butter.
steps: Mix one pound of flour with six eggs, one tablespoon of brandy, a good pinch of salt, one tablespoon of oil, and two tablespoons of orange blossom water
Mix milk and water in equal quantities and use to make the batter liquid until it has the consistency of a thick porridge or atole
Heat a clear fire with fine charcoal and place a pan on it
Melt a small piece of lard (or butter or oil if necessary, though lard is better) in the pan
Pour one ladle of batter, spreading it so it covers the entire bottom of the pan, making a very thin tortilla
When cooked on one side, flip to cook the other side
Serve very hot

title: Encrespados Ingleses (English Pancakes)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, brandy, and rum.
steps: Beat six to eight egg yolks in one-quarter cuartillo of milk, mixing until the beaten mixture is thick
Gradually add flour that has been mixed with milk (prepared beforehand), stirring and mixing constantly
Add two tablespoons of ground ginger, one cuartillo of refined Catalan brandy, and a little salt, stirring and mixing well
Make sure the pan is well washed and clean, place a piece of butter the size of a nut in it
Pour the batter so it covers the bottom, making it three times thicker than the French crêpes
Sprinkle the pancakes on plates with rum and sugar; they are dry and crusty

title: Encrespados Polacos (Polish Pancakes)
description: Prepared with milk or cream, lemon rind, and raisins.
steps: Mix and beat eight eggs with three-quarters of one cuartillo of milk or cream, two ounces of melted fresh butter, grated nutmeg, lemon rind grated with sugar, a little salt, and ten ounces of flour
Place butter or lard in the pan in the same quantity as for the previous pancakes and pour the batter in the same manner
As soon as the batter is poured, sprinkle Corinth raisins (or muscatel raisins if the other is unavailable) on it
Flip the pancake, let it cook, place it on a plate, dust with sugar, roll it with a carving fork with two long tines, and serve very hot

title: Enormous Eggs (Huevos Enormes)
description: Prepared with eggs.
steps: Break twelve or more eggs, separating the whites from the yolks
Remove the skins from the yolks, and gathering all of them in a clean bladder, tie it with a thread so that it forms a round ball
Put water to boil in a pot and throw the bladder there, hanging it from the thread so it does not stick to the bottom

When it is considered that the yolks have set well, remove them, and as soon as they are cold, remove the skin of the bladder and there will remain a large yolk that will be accommodated in another bladder, putting the whites there, ensuring that the yolk remains in the middle and the bladder is oval-shaped

Cook again in hot water, removing it when it has set, and when cold, remove the bladder, and there will remain an enormous egg, which can be served whole or in halves, or in slices that partake of the white and the yolk, presenting it with a sauce corresponding to hard-boiled eggs, or in oil and vinegar, adorned with sliced onion, oregano and chopped parsley

title: Ensalada de Alcachofas (Artichoke Salad)
description: A salad made with artichokes, garlic, and vinegar.
steps: Wash the artichokes first
Remove the top leaves and cut the tail and tips
Cook until half done with salt and drain
Fry a little oil with garlic until it browns
Grind a little pepper, clove, and cinnamon and mix with the rest
In a regular pot place the artichokes face up
Cover with oil until it rises two fingers above the artichokes and add a spoonful of Castilian vinegar
Cover the pot with cloth
When serving decorate with vinegar, chiles, capers, and olives

title: Ensalada de Alcachofas con Xitomate (Artichoke Salad with Tomato)
description: A salad made with artichokes, garlic, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: One quarter liter per dozen artichokes
ingredients.sourceText: One quarter liter per dozen artichokes

steps: Cook the artichokes with garlic and salt, and cook plenty of xitomates separately, which will be ground.
In a pan put one quarter liter of oil for each dozen artichokes and fry whole garlic cloves in it.
With the garlic fried, add the xitomate, which will be left to fry well with black pepper and clove.
Then add the artichokes, a little vinegar, breadcrumbs, and the appropriate salt.
When taken to the table, all the broth that the xitomate gives should have been consumed, so that they are only moist.
Serve hot.

title: Ensalada de Pepinos a la Inglesa (English Cucumber Salad)
description: A salad made with cucumbers, vinegar, and onion.
steps: Clean two cucumbers that are not perfectly ripe; if they have a bitter tip, they are worthless and should be replaced with others; but if the tip is not bitter, which can be known by tasting them, cut them into wheels or slices along the length, as thin as possible
Place them in a serving dish with salt, pepper, vinegar, and a sliced onion
Let them pickle this way for two hours
Remove part of their liquid and serve with roast beef

title: Entripado de Cerdo con Leche (Pork Tripe Sausage with Milk)
description: Prepared with tripe, pork, and milk.

ingredients.name: pork fat without salt
ingredients.sourceText: twelve ounces pork fat without salt

ingredients.name: pound and a half of pork ribs
ingredients.sourceText: pound and a half of pork ribs

steps: Parboil the pork, chicken and sweetbreads, cutting the fat into small pieces and heating it with white onion
Then add the pork, then the sweetbreads, and successively the chicken and chopped parsley
Remove from fire and season with salt, pepper, cinnamon, clove and nutmeg
Cook the milk with the egg yolks over gentle heat without letting it stay long on the fire, and mix with everything said
Fill the tripes with all this mixture
Pierce the filled tripes with a larding needle
Put them in boiling water with whole onions, parsley, laurel, basil, clove and wine to cook
This will take about two hours
Grease them with lard and roll them in bread crumbs
Grill them over the grate

title: Escorzoneras Preparadas (Prepared Black Salsify)
description: Prepared with salsify, vinegar, and sauce.

Dress with white or red sauce and serve as a side dish

title: Escubac (Liqueur)
description: Prepared with brandy, lemons, and bitter almonds.

ingredients.name: Peels from four lemons, cleaned of flesh
ingredients.sourceText: Peels from four lemons, cleaned of flesh

steps: Dilute one jug of refined brandy with four cuartillos of water
In six cuartillos of refined brandy, infuse {{source-3}} to extract the tincture
Pour the diluted brandy into a large bottle with the cleaned lemon peels, cilantro, cinnamon, mace, cloves, and bitter almonds, all ground
Leave in infusion for eight days
After this time, add the saffron and its tincture (passed through a sieve), saving some for coloring the liqueur
Distill in a bain-marie in the ordinary manner
Dissolve {{source-10}} in twelve cuartillos of water, clarifying the syrup perfectly
Sweeten the distilled product with this syrup, mix with the saffron tincture, and filter through a cloth

description: Prepared with lamb shoulder, onions, and turnip or parsnip.

Degrease the sauce and serve it over the shoulder

title: Espaldilla de Vaca en Galantina (Beef Shoulder in Galantine)
description: Prepared with beef shoulder, lard, and bay leaves.

ingredients.name: lard for each pound of meat
ingredients.sourceText: lard for each pound of meat

steps: Debone an entire beef shoulder
Make a hash with part of the meat, adding for each pound another pound of lard, both chopped
Mix in spice powder, four bay leaves, a little thyme, and a good bunch of parsley and small onions
Moisten with broth, or lacking this, with water and salt
Extend the hash to the thickness of a finger over the shoulder
Place strips of ham, scarlet tongue, and truffles on top, adding strips of carrot if desired
To mottle the galantine, cover all ingredients with hash and place strips of ham, truffles, etc. on top again, covering again with hash
Roll the shoulder lengthwise, reuniting and pressing the meats well
Tie with strong thread and cover with lard
Wrap tightly in canvas, then in clean cloth and tie to maintain shape
Place in a braising pan lined with lard slices, veal slices, two veal feet, shoulder bones, six carrots, and eight to ten onions of those of spice
Moisten with reduced broth and cook, examining if the shoulder is done before removing from heat
Press to extract all liquid and let cool
Strain the gelatin through a fine cloth and put eggs in a pan, beating well
Pour the gelatin over and mix both thoroughly
Add thick peppercorns and four spices, a bay leaf, a little thyme, and a small handful of parsley leaves
Incorporate all and let boil
When it boils, place the pan at the edge of the stove, cover with its lid and put fire on top
Leave half an hour in this position so everything simmers gently
Strain the gelatin through a cloth without pressing, only moving the gelatin inside so it passes to the other side
Let cool, and when set, surround the galantine with it after it is arranged on a plate
Do not forget to season the hash with salt, thick pepper, a little four spices and finely chopped parsley, and when about to use, mix in egg yolks, blending well

title: Espuma de Natas a la Francesa (French Whipped Cream Foam)
description: Prepared with cream, powdered sugar, and gum arabic.

ingredients.name: four quartillos of double, very fresh cream
ingredients.sourceText: four quartillos of double, very fresh cream

ingredients.name: gum adragant or gum arabic in powder, the amount that can be taken with three fingers
ingredients.sourceText: gum adragant or gum arabic in powder, the amount that can be taken with three fingers

ingredients.name: equal quantity of candied orange blossom, ground
ingredients.sourceText: equal quantity of candied orange blossom, ground

steps: Place the cream, powdered sugar, gum adragant or gum arabic in powder, candied orange blossom ground, and bergamot essence in a stoneware vessel
Once the sugar has dissolved, crush {{source-5}} and place in a basin with saltpeter
Position the vessel containing the cream on the snow to cool it
Beat the cream with the instrument used for beating egg whites until it turns to foam more quickly
As the cream turns to foam, remove it with a skimmer, comb, or rake, and place in a sieve positioned over a basin
If the cream does not foam as needed, add two egg whites to help it along
Once all the beaten cream has been placed in the sieve, if it is not sufficient, collect what has passed through the sieve, beat it again, and combine with the other

Typically these foams are placed in gilded or silver cups made for this purpose; if not available, use glass or crystal cups placed in a kind of tin cave made for this purpose, which has a grill in the shape of the cups to place them on
Place crushed snow mixed with saltpeter underneath and also on top of the cave cover, which should be in the manner of the cover of a bell oven, with a kind of channel or gutter for water to drain
These foams can hold for two or three hours before serving

title: Estofado Catalán (Catalan Stew)
description: Prepared with meat, onion, and tomato.

ingredients.name: four or five almonds with shell
ingredients.sourceText: four or five almonds with shell

steps: Cut the meat into pieces and fry in a pot until the water it releases is consumed.
Add plenty of coarsely cut onion, let it brown, and add ground tomato to brown as well.
Once done, add the necessary water and a little vinegar, bay leaf, thyme, and oregano.
Cover the pot with a napkin and an inverted plate and place over very gentle heat.
Grind clove, cinnamon, and pepper with four or five almonds with shell and add to the meat.

When the meat is almost cooked, fry raw potatoes, add a little Sherry wine to the stew and a spoonful of Catalan brandy, and soon add the potatoes, then leave it almost without fire so it finishes cooking with the heat of the embers.

title: Estofado de Bifteks (Beef Steak Stew)
description: Prepared with beef steaks, broth, and onion.
steps: Take thicker beef steaks than those that should be cooked on grills and brown them in butter inside a pan, turning them so they take color on both sides.

Remove them from the pan and add to the butter it contains one tablespoon of flour; stir actively so it makes a good-colored roux, and mix with good broth, in sufficient quantity so the steaks, placed back in the pan, are completely covered.
When the sauce begins to boil, add a bouquet of fine herbs, one onion, one carrot, and half a turnip, all cut into very thin slices.
Season with salt and pepper and let cook gradually for two or three hours.

Half an hour before serving, add to the sauce three tablespoons of flour mixed with pepper, and four or five small onions browned separately in butter. This stew is very delicious if not overloaded with spices.

title: Esturión en Fricando (Sturgeon Braised as Fricandeau)
description: Prepared with ham or eel or anchovies, beef, and ham.

ingredients.name: Ham, thin sliced or anguila (eel) and anchovies
ingredients.sourceText: Ham, thin sliced or anguila (eel) and anchovies

steps: Lift the skin and bony strips from a good piece of sturgeon, which will be lightly beaten with the flat of a machete.
If the fricandeau is to be made with meat, lard the sturgeon with thin ham; but if it is to be cooked in the lean version, lard it with eel and anchovies.
For the first case, line a pot with beef slices, slices of ham, some carrots, onions, and aromatic herbs.
Place the fish on top, moistening with white wine and covering with buttered paper, letting the fricandeau cook.
After this operation is complete and the sturgeon is well set or iced, pass the cooking liquid through a silk sieve, and once defatted, let it reduce with three spoonfuls of Spanish sauce.
Pour it over the fricandeau, which is already arranged on the plate in which it is to be served.

title: Extracto de Buey para el Enfermo (Beef Extract for the Sick)
description: Prepared with beef, water, and salt.

ingredients.name: beef with skin and muscular fat removed
ingredients.sourceText: one pound of beef with skin and muscular fat removed

steps: Mince the beef meat as if making morcillas
Add salt to the water and put the meat in it
Place over a slow fire so it maintains for two hours at a temperature near boiling but without actually boiling
After two hours, skim off the foam that has risen to the surface, stirring occasionally without uncovering
After skimming well, return to the fire, increase the heat somewhat and let it boil for about a quarter hour
Remove the pot from the fire and pass the broth through a very fine sieve
When the extract has cooled sufficiently, remove all the fat accumulated on the surface
This is the best meat extract for a convalescent

title: Faisán a la Périgourdienne (Pheasant Perigourdian-Style)
description: Prepared with pheasant, truffle, and ham.

ingredients.name: game sauce or pheasant broth
ingredients.sourceText: 3 tablespoons game sauce or pheasant broth

steps: Empty and singe the pheasant at the flame
Break the two breast bones and remove from the neck opening to avoid damaging the tail
Finely mince 1.5 pounds of ground truffle that has been washed and trimmed thinly on the outside, setting the thin parts aside separately
Heat {{source-2}}, {{source-3}}, and 4 ounces oil in a pan
In this mixture, soften or render the separated truffle parts cut into walnut-sized pieces, adding salt, coarse pepper, cinnamon, clove, fine pepper and nutmeg
Let them boil for five minutes in the ham, then add the other finely minced truffles and let cool
When the picadillo is cold, fill the pheasant through the neck opening, closing the hole with a thin slice of ham covered with pheasant skin
After folding the legs as done with fattened hens, tie them and secure the neck skin well to prevent the truffles from escaping
Place the pheasant in a pan between two layers of ham slices and cover with pan sauce without lemon, covering all with a wheel of buttered paper
Cook at low heat for one hour
When ready to serve, drain the pheasant and untie it carefully, arrange it on a plate
For the sauce: fry two sliced truffles in butter, then add {{source-12}} and 3 tablespoons game sauce or the broth in which the pheasant cooked, reducing until half remains and degreasing afterwards

steps: Pound {{source-0}} and place in a pan with equal quantity of flour, {{source-2}}, 2 egg yolks and 1 whole egg, zest of green lemon, {{source-6}} and a little salt
Dissolve all this in 1 quart of milk
Place over heat to reach cream consistency
Pour into tartlet molds that have been lined with puff pastry
Place in oven on a baking sheet
When the fanchonetas are almost cooked, remove them and brush with meringue batter
Sprinkle with coarse sugar and return to oven to achieve a beautiful golden color

title: Fideos (Pasta de) (Noodle Dough)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, melted butter, and yeast.

ingredients.name: half a cup of melted butter
ingredients.sourceText: half a cup of melted butter

ingredients.name: 1 piece of yeast the size of an egg, dissolved in a cup of warm water
ingredients.sourceText: 1 piece of yeast the size of an egg, dissolved in a cup of warm water

steps: Mix the flour with the egg yolks, melted butter, and the yeast dissolved in warm water
Season with a little salt
Knead together thoroughly until it acquires the proper consistency
Place in molds through the concave part, pressing so that the noodles come out through the holes on the opposite side
As they reach a quarter in length or the desired size, roll them gently so they do not stick to one another
Spread to dry in the sun for three days on clean napkins
When completely dry, store for use
Do not accumulate a large quantity, as after a certain time they spoil and corrupt completely

title: Filete con Mantequilla (Filet with Butter)
description: Prepared with lemon, melted butter, and potatoes.
steps: Take one filet and flatten it whole until it is the thickness of a finger, and sprinkled with salt, pepper, and lemon, leave it until mealtime.
When the soup is served, place it on the grills and brown it, turning it from one side to the other.
Once browned, have melted butter and mix it with the substance that has distilled from the filet while roasting, and coat it on top, breading it on one side and the other.
Serve with fried or toasted potatoes.

title: Flan de Leche (Milk Flan)
description: Prepared with milk, egg yolks, and sugar.

ingredients.name: sugar for caramel
ingredients.sourceText: six ounces of sugar for caramel

steps: Boil four cuartillos of milk with a stick of cinnamon and a green lemon peel
Let it thicken until it resembles atole and cool
Beat twelve egg yolks until very stiff
Mix with the milk, {{source-4}}, beat again and strain
Grind six ounces of sugar and place in a pan to form caramel
When it foams heavily, pour into a tinplate mold to cover all sides well
When cooled, pour the milk mixture and place to cook in a water bath
Place fire on top until it browns and is well cooked

title: Flan de Leche (Milk Flan)
description: Prepared with milk, egg yolks, and white sugar.

ingredients.name: flour or starch
ingredients.sourceText: one tablespoon of flour or starch

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of sugar for caramel
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of sugar for caramel

ingredients.name: lemon peel shavings or lemon essence
ingredients.sourceText: lemon peel shavings or lemon essence

steps: Beat sixteen egg yolks very well
Add {{source-1}} and {{source-2}}, beat until well mixed
Melt one quarter pound of sugar in a pot without adding water
When at the point of clear caramel, coat the interior of the pot with it
Add the yolks, one cuartillo of good milk and mix with the egg and sugar very slowly
Stir much with a wooden spoon
When well mixed, add lemon peel shavings or a few drops of lemon essence
Place on fire with a cover filled with embers on top
When set, remove and let cool, then place on the serving plate
If desired with coffee flavor, cook the milk first with a small bag of coffee, then remove it
To know if the flan is ready, insert a straw and upon removing it you will know how it is

title: Flan de Leche (Milk Flan)
description: Prepared with milk, orange, and egg yolks.
steps: Boil three cuartillos of milk until reduced to two
Sweeten sufficiently and let boil another while
Add two orange leaves and give two boils, remove and stir so it does not form lumps
When lukewarm, mix with seven egg yolks and one egg white that have been beaten beforehand
Strain everything through a colander
Prepare a pot with powdered sugar made into light-colored caramel by means of fire
Pour the preparation into this pot and cook in a water bath

title: Flaon Inglés en Pudding (English Custard Pudding)
description: A pudding made with cream, egg yolks, and sugar.

ingredients.name: 4 quarters of a cup of cream
ingredients.sourceText: 4 quarters of a cup of cream

steps: Bring 4 quarters of a cup of cream to boil with a piece of cinnamon and {{source-2}}
After it cools, mix in 5 well-beaten egg yolks
Return to the fire, stirring until it becomes slightly thick and taking care not to let it boil
Remove from heat and when it has cooled again, butter a piece of clean linen
Dust the butter with flour and pour the custard into it
Tie at the four corners so the custard cannot escape
Place in a pot of water and let it boil for three-quarters of an hour
Remove the custard from the fire

title: Flaón (Custard Pudding)
description: A pudding made with cream, egg yolks, and madeira.
steps: Boil four cuartillos of cream with a piece of cinnamon and {{source-2}}
After cooling, mix in five well-beaten egg yolks
Return to fire, stirring until it becomes somewhat thick, taking care not to let it boil
Set aside and let cool
Butter a clean piece of linen and dust it with flour
Pour the flaón into it and tie at the four corners so the flaón cannot escape
Place in a pot with water and let boil for three quarters of an hour
Remove from fire with great caution so it does not break
Let cool in an appropriate vessel
Untie the linen and arrange the flaón on a plate
Dust with sugar and serve cold with a sauce made of equal parts melted butter and Madeira wine

title: Flaón de Sémola Amerengada (Meringued Semolina Pudding)
description: A pudding made with semolina, pastry, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: orange blossom or grated lemon peel
ingredients.sourceText: orange blossom or grated lemon peel

steps: Prepare pastry dough as for hot pastry crust
Pour semolina into boiling milk like beaten eggs and let drain
Add egg yolks, sugar, orange blossom or grated lemon peel, crushed bitter almond macaroons and marzipan
Mix everything with a little salt and one egg's worth of melted butter
Beat half of the egg whites lightly and fold in with the other ingredients
Pour the semolina into the flaón three quarters of an hour before serving
Bake in a gently heated oven
Let it rise well, then beat the remaining egg whites
Mix with powdered sugar and a little candied orange blossom
Lightly knead and cover the flaón with this mixture
Brush with granulated sugar
When golden in color, serve

title: Flaón Suizo (Swiss Pudding)
description: A pudding made with pastry, cream, and potato starch.

ingredients.name: half a pound of melted butter
ingredients.sourceText: half a pound of melted butter

steps: Prepare the pastry crust as in the previous article
Boil two cuartillos of cream with {{source-2}}
Make a paste with potato starch flour instead of common flour
Knead this paste in a bowl with salt and pepper, half a pound of melted butter and grated Gruyère cheese, an equal amount of Parma and Neufchâtel cheese
Mix everything with raw egg yolks, making the paste more consistent than cake batter
Beat half of the egg whites whose yolks were used and fold gently into the mass
Pour immediately into the prepared pastry crust
Cover with thick buttered paper tied with string
Bake in a moderately hot oven
When cooked, arrange on a plate, remove the paper and serve

title: Frailas y Monjas (Fried Honey Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with biscuits, sugar, and butter.

ingredients.name: three loaves of sugar of a pound and a half each
ingredients.sourceText: three loaves of sugar of a pound and a half each

steps: Make a honey mixture with three loaves of sugar of a pound and a half each and half a pound of butter
While it comes to a boil, beat eight eggs, first the whites and then the yolks
Mix the beaten eggs with ten or twelve hard biscuits that have been crushed and a little ground clove
When the honey and butter mixture is boiling, remove it from the heat and place it on the embers so that one person stirs it constantly while another adds the eggs
Finish cooking over two fires

title: Frangipán o Bartolillo (Almond Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with sweet almonds, bitter almonds, and macaroons.

ingredients.name: a little candied orange blossom in powder
ingredients.sourceText: a little candied orange blossom in powder

ingredients.name: or roasted, cleaned and split peanuts instead of almonds without orange blossom
ingredients.sourceText: or roasted, cleaned and split peanuts instead of almonds without orange blossom

ingredients.name: or pine nuts, hazelnuts or small walnuts
ingredients.sourceText: or pine nuts, hazelnuts or small walnuts

steps: Put half a pound of flour in a saucepan and dissolve it with as many eggs as needed, then add four quartillos of milk, {{source-3}} and a little salt
Put this mixture on the fire, stirring the paste constantly with a wooden spoon until it has boiled for about a quarter of an hour, taking care that it does not stick
When you know that the dough is cooked, remove it and let it cool

Split ten sweet almonds, two bitter ones and three or four macaroons, adding a little candied orange blossom in powder, mixing everything with the dough, which is sweetened with ground and sifted sugar
Stir and mix well the mixture with the wooden spoon, and form the frangipans or bartolillos, more or less thick, according to the quantity of eggs that you want to add
When you want to make them with peanuts, put these toasted, cleaned and split in place of the almonds and omit the orange blossom
They can also be made with pine nuts, hazelnuts or small walnuts

title: Fricando Seco de Pulpas de Ternera (Dry Veal Loin Fricassee)
description: Prepared with veal, orange juice, and ham.
steps: Shape the veal loins into rounds like cheeses
Soak in orange juice and water
The next day dry with a cloth
Stud with long strips of ham
Cook in a pot with equal parts water and vinegar, bay leaves, thyme, crushed garlic, abundant spices, a tablespoon of lard and carrot slices
When the meat is cooked, coat with oil and lard
Place at two fires to brown lightly
Serve in a sauce of green quelites seasoned with garlic, onion, cumin and a small amount of water, as it should remain dry
When placing the meat in the sauce, garnish with carrot wheels

title: Fricandó de Pulpa de Ternera con Espinacas (Veal Fricandeau with Spinach)
description: Prepared with veal, spinach, and fat.

ingredients.name: well-worked veal pulp
ingredients.sourceText: One pound of well-worked veal pulp

ingredients.name: fat ham, cut into thick lards
ingredients.sourceText: One pound of fat ham, cut into thick lards

steps: Prepare a well-worked veal pulp, cutting it like a ball or wheel at the thickest part
Divide it in half and flatten with the flat of a machete
Cut one pound of fat ham into thick lards and lard the meat so the ends stick out the sides
Leave to soak in cold water
Cook with onion slices, crushed garlic head, carrot slices, and a little vinegar
When the meat is cooked, place in a casserole without disturbing the larding, on pork fat or lard so it does not stick
Finish cooking on two gentle fires or in an oven, having previously seasoned with a little pepper, clove, and vinegar
Fry cooked and ground spinach in lard, also frying finely chopped onion and chopped garlic in the same
Season with salt, add covered red wine
Serve the fricandó over this sauce, adorning the contour with breadcrumb figurines fried in lard

Should be brought to the table whole, on a sauce of cooked quellites seasoned with garlic, onion and a little cumin
They should remain dry when served and are adorned with carrot slices

The next day, coat with lemon, stud with ham and place in a saucepan with equal parts water and vinegar with bay leaves, thyme, crushed garlic, plenty of spices, cinnamon, clove and pepper, and a spoonful of butter and carrot slices
When cooked, coat with oil and butter, and place over two fires until half-browned

title: Fricasé de Gazapo sin Huevo (Rabbit Fricassee without Egg)
description: Prepared with rabbit, broth, and carrots.
steps: Divide the rabbit into pieces
Cook in broth that covers them completely, seasoning with salt, pepper, nutmeg, and spices
Add two carrots, four onions, two turnips, three stalks of celery, and one mixed bouquet
When the vegetables are cooked, remove them and reduce to substance
If the rabbit is already cooked, strain the broth through a sieve; otherwise let the meat cook more
After straining the broth, make a somewhat thick sauce with it and the vegetable substance
Pour over the rabbit to serve

title: Fricasé de Pollo (Chicken Fricassee)
description: Prepared with chicken, white pepper, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice or verjuice or vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: Lemon juice or verjuice or vinegar

steps: Pluck, singe over flame, and empty the chicken
Quarter it and soak in cold water for one to two hours so the meat becomes white
Drain the pieces
Put a little butter and a spoonful of flour in a saucepan and stir until the butter melts
Add a glass of water with salt, white pepper, nutmeg scrapings, and a bouquet of parsley with small onions
Put the chicken pieces in this broth and cook for three quarters of an hour
Make a separate sauce with three egg yolks and lemon juice, or verjuice, or a dash of vinegar
If adding mushrooms, do so when the chicken is more than half cooked
If mixing onions and artichoke hearts, add these to the broth at the same time as the chicken
Serve with crayfish, fried toast, and rooster combs around the plate
To keep the chicken meat white, rub with lemon and cover while cooking with a wheel of buttered paper placed on the fricassee inside the saucepan

title: Frijoles Veracruzanos (Beans Veracruz Style)
description: Prepared with black beans, lard, and garlic.

ingredients.name: Half a small cup of tequisquite water settled (optional)
ingredients.sourceText: Half a small cup of tequisquite water settled (optional)

steps: After washing the sierra beans to remove dust, put them to cook in water with a little lard, and if desired, although not necessary, with half a small cup of settled tequisquite water.
When they are cooked, fry sliced garlic cloves in oil and as soon as they brown, remove them from the oil.
Fry in the same oil a little chopped onion, which is not removed.
Pour the beans with the water in which they were cooked over this, setting aside a handful of them to be ground.
Add lard, the handful of ground beans, quarters of onion if desired, and the corresponding salt, not forgetting that if you overdo it, the beans will be salty when they thicken.
Let most of the broth reduce and once the beans are well fried, serve them, putting aside chopped little onions, grated cheese, and an oil cruet, so that each person can season them to their taste.

title: Frijoles Veracruzanos (Veracruz-Style Beans)
description: Prepared with beans, lard, and garlic.
steps: Wash beans to remove dust and cook in water with a little lard; when cooked set aside
In a cazuela fry sliced garlic cloves in oil, remove from oil once golden
In the same oil fry a small amount of chopped onion
Add the beans with the water they cooked in
Set aside two or three spoonfuls of beans to grind
Add the cooked beans to the cazuela with lard, onion slices, the ground beans and salt
Let the broth reduce and re-fry the beans
While re-frying with plenty of lard mash with a spoon and gradually add breadcrumbs, re-fry until they form a molote
Serve very hot

title: Fritura de Criadillas de Tierra (Fried Truffles)
description: Prepared with truffles, butter, and salt.
steps: After cleaning the truffles well, peel them, round them, and cut them into slices two lines thick.
Melt butter in a pan and place the truffles on top with a little salt and coarse pepper.
Put the pan over a fairly brisk fire, and after the truffles have boiled a few times in the butter, turn them over.
Three minutes are sufficient for them to cook perfectly.
When cooked, drain them and put them in refined Spanish sauce, and arrange them on the plate to serve as an intermediate course.

title: Fritura de Gallina en Leche (Fried Chicken in Milk)
description: Prepared with chicken, milk, and onion.

ingredients.name: raw chicken killed the previous day
ingredients.sourceText: raw chicken killed the previous day

steps: Roast raw a chicken killed the previous day, and after it is cool, remove all the bones and mince the meat very finely.
Fry in butter a little minced onion, two garlic cloves and a small amount of flour, then adding a quarter liter of milk and letting everything boil until it thickens.
Put the minced chicken, and season with salt, cloves and cinnamon, adding a little minced parsley.
Let the fricassee cool and mix in two eggs, stirring them in.
Take portions with a spoon, or give the paste the shape of balls, pears or other forms, which rolling in breadcrumbs or ground biscuit and coating with beaten egg, are fried and served.

description: Prepared with brains, artichokes, and chicken.
steps: Compose the dish of brains, artichokes, chicken giblets, lamb testicles and tongue or beef tongue.
Cook everything separately and divide into medium-sized pieces that are put to fry in a pan with butter or margarine and the corresponding salt.
Dissolve a little flour in half a glass of water, sufficient so that the water is not clear, but like broth, and add it to the fricassee.

When it has boiled well and consumed what is necessary, remove from the heat while very hot and dissolve two or three egg yolks, which are stirred together with the rest, and adding cloves and pepper, serve immediately.

title: Frutas de Sartén de Gallina y Leche (Fried Chicken and Milk Fritters)
description: Prepared with chicken, milk, and onion.

Mix everything very well with two eggs and let it cool
Form the fritters, roll them in breadcrumbs and coat them with egg
Fry them and serve

Bathe them with half-beaten egg
Roll them in ground biscuit or toasted and ground bread
Fry them
They can be served immediately, but they are better if left from one day to the next

title: Galantina de Guaxolote (Turkey Galantine)
description: Prepared with turkey, meat or hens or beef, and fat.

ingredients.name: Carnes de dos pollas or vaco (meat from two hens or beef)
ingredients.sourceText: Carnes de dos pollas or vaco (meat from two hens or beef)

ingredients.name: Mechas medianas de jamón (medium ham lards)
ingredients.sourceText: Mechas medianas de jamón (medium ham lards)

steps: Singe the turkey over a flame and bone it, starting from the loin
Remove all nerves from the legs
Lift some meat from the legs and breast and combine with meat from two hens or beef
Weigh the meat and add an equal amount of pure fat ham
Chop all together and season with salt, pepper, and fine herbs
Season medium ham lards with ground spices, salt, and pepper, and lard the turkey meat with them
Spread a layer of filling about one inch thick, smoothing it evenly
Place on top truffles cut lengthwise, ham lards, strips of turkey and other poultry meat, and thin slices of clean almonds
Cover with another layer of filling
Alternate layers until all filling is used
Roll the turkey to contain all the filling without spilling, and sew the meat closed with a needle to give it an elongated shape
Cover with ham slices sprinkled with a little salt
Wrap in a napkin with four or five bay leaves and tie the napkin at the ends
Bind the galantine on top to maintain its shape
Place in a braising pan lined with ham slices
Add two veal shanks, a bunch of parsley and onion, the scraps from the turkey, four bay leaves, a little thyme, three cloves, and three ladles of broth
Leave to cook over low heat for five hours
Remove the galantine from the pan and press gently to extract the broth
Keep in the same napkin until it cools to serve
Strain the broth through a fine napkin and break in one or two eggs according to quantity, beating them in and tasting for flavor
Place over the fire, stirring the galantine without stopping until it boils
Set aside at the edge of the stove, cover with a lid, keeping a hot fire on top for half an hour
Strain through a fine napkin and let cool for serving

sourceIngredients: Carnes de dos pollas or vaco (meat from two hens or beef)
Mechas medianas de jamón (medium ham lards)
sourceSteps: Singe the turkey over a flame and bone it, starting from the loin
Remove all nerves from the legs
Lift some meat from the legs and breast and combine with meat from two hens or beef
Weigh the meat and add an equal amount of pure fat ham
Chop all together and season with salt, pepper, and fine herbs
Season medium ham lards with ground spices, salt, and pepper, and lard the turkey meat with them
Spread a layer of filling about one inch thick, smoothing it evenly
Place on top truffles cut lengthwise, ham lards, strips of turkey and other poultry meat, and thin slices of clean almonds
Cover with another layer of filling
Alternate layers until all filling is used
Roll the turkey to contain all the filling without spilling, and sew the meat closed with a needle to give it an elongated shape
Cover with ham slices sprinkled with a little salt
Wrap in a napkin with four or five bay leaves and tie the napkin at the ends
Bind the galantine on top to maintain its shape
Place in a braising pan lined with ham slices
Add two veal shanks, a bunch of parsley and onion, the scraps from the turkey, four bay leaves, a little thyme, three cloves, and three ladles of broth
Leave to cook over low heat for five hours
Remove the galantine from the pan and press gently to extract the broth
Keep in the same napkin until it cools to serve
Strain the broth through a fine napkin and break in one or two eggs according to quantity, beating them in and tasting for flavor
Place over the fire, stirring the galantine without stopping until it boils
Set aside at the edge of the stove, cover with a lid, keeping a hot fire on top for half an hour
Strain through a fine napkin and let cool for serving

Open it along the belly and remove the backbone

Close the salmon to give it its natural shape
Wrap it in a napkin, place it to cook in light broth, and let it cool

steps: Cook the chickens well, then cut into quarters.
Mince onion, tomatoes, garlic, and bergamot pear.
Fry some sliced cooked ham.
Grind a little cinnamon, pepper, garlic cloves, and a few cumin seeds.
Grease a casserole with butter and make a layer of the minced vegetables and ham.
Add a layer of chicken pieces, sprinkle with some spices dissolved in water and dust with flour.
Continue alternating layers of vegetables, chicken dusted with flour, and spices, concluding with a final layer of vegetables and ham.
Cook over two gentle fires, adding a little broth or water.
When the broth is consumed and the vegetables are cooked, remove from heat.
Beat four egg whites with a pinch of flour, and pour over the dish.
Place a griddle with some heat on top to brown it, then dust with ground sugar.
Serve the chickens in the same dish without disturbing it.
Prepare lamb or beef tongue slices cooked in equal parts water and vinegar with salt, plenty of garlic, onion, and peppercorns, cooking overnight on gentle heat.
Cook brains with salt, slice them, roll in breadcrumbs, and fry with a little salt and pepper.
Arrange the tongue and brain slices on top of the casserole and scatter blanched and finely minced onion over all.

sourceSteps: Cook the chickens well, then cut into quarters.
Mince onion, tomatoes, garlic, and bergamot pear.
Fry some sliced cooked ham.
Grind a little cinnamon, pepper, garlic cloves, and a few cumin seeds.
Grease a casserole with butter and make a layer of the minced vegetables and ham.
Add a layer of chicken pieces, sprinkle with some spices dissolved in water and dust with flour.
Continue alternating layers of vegetables, chicken dusted with flour, and spices, concluding with a final layer of vegetables and ham.
Cook over two gentle fires, adding a little broth or water.

Beat four egg whites with a pinch of flour, and pour over the dish.
Place a griddle with some heat on top to brown it, then dust with ground sugar.
Serve the chickens in the same dish without disturbing it.
Prepare lamb or beef tongue slices cooked in equal parts water and vinegar with salt, plenty of garlic, onion, and peppercorns, cooking overnight on gentle heat.
Cook brains with salt, slice them, roll in breadcrumbs, and fry with a little salt and pepper.
Arrange the tongue and brain slices on top of the casserole and scatter blanched and finely minced onion over all.

title: Gallinas Rellenas en Empanada (Stuffed Hens in Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with hens, lard, and breadcrumbs.

steps: After cooking the hens, stuff them with any of the prepared picadillos or as turkeys are stuffed
Coat them with lard and cover completely on all sides with breadcrumbs
Wrap them in the prepared dough and place on sheet metal to cook in the oven, ensuring the dough browns well and the hens cook without burning

Extend the dough with a rolling pin to regular thickness, place the hens on top already covered with breadcrumbs and sufficient lard, wrap them in the dough and cut away excess pieces

title: Gallinas á la Tártara (Hen Tartare Style)
description: Prepared with hens, lard, and garlic.
steps: Clean and prepare two hens, breaking the leg bones
Put a little lard in a casserole with salt and pepper and place the hens over two fires
A quarter hour before serving, remove them and place on a grill over low heat, changing their position so they take color
Cut two or three garlic cloves into pieces, a little chervil and oregano
Put everything in a casserole with mustard, a little vinegar, salt and pepper to taste
Add a small amount of oil, stirring constantly so it mixes; if it thickens too much add a little vinegar
Coat the hens with this sauce when serving

title: Gangas Guisadas (Braised Guans)
description: Prepared with garlic, chiles, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: two mulato or ancho chiles, well destemmed
ingredients.sourceText: two mulato or ancho chiles, well destemmed

ingredients.sourceText: a little ground clove and cinnamon

steps: After cleaning the guans well, put them to cook with two whole garlic heads, two mulato or ancho chiles very well destemmed, corresponding salt, some water and the same amount of vinegar.
When cooked, remove the broth and let cool.
When cold, skim it to collect the fat that has released.

Put this fat in a casserole with a bit of oil and fry a portion of capers, desalted and ground, with a handful of parsley leaves, a bit of grated kid goat or veal liver, adding it with broth from that in which the guans were cooked and a little ground clove and cinnamon.
When it is almost thickened, season with corresponding salt and serve.

title: Ganso en Adobo (Marinated Goose)
description: Prepared with goose, bacon, and onions.
steps: Preferably take an old goose, empty it and hold its legs inside the body, blanch and pluck it.
Lard the entire body with bacon strips wrapped in breadcrumbs and seasoned with parsley, onions, garlic all finely chopped; a bay leaf, thyme, basil almost reduced to powder, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
After larding, tie it and place it in a pot of its size with two glasses of water, two of white wine, half glass of aguardiente, onions and carrots, salt and pepper.
Cover the pot well and cook over low heat for four hours.
Once cooked, place the marinated goose on a platter; if the sauce is too thin, reduce it and pour it over the goose, after it has been garnished with carrots and onions cooked with it.
One can also let it cool, pour over it the same sauce and not serve it until the sauce is made into aspic: but this method is not the most used. The goose is always preferred hot.

Stir over the fire until the dough pulls away from the pan
Remove from heat and add one whole egg while the dough is hot, stirring well to incorporate
Continue adding eggs one by one until the dough runs between the fingers
Return briefly to the fire, then remove again
Continue adding eggs one by one as many as the dough can absorb, along with crumbled or crushed sweet macaroons, candied and ground orange blossom, and lemon zest
Form gâteaux of desired size and cook separately
Top with roasted and cleaned peanuts mixed with fine sugar and egg white, then dry briefly in the oven

title: Gato Hojaldrado (Puff Pastry Gâteau)
description: A pastry dish made with flour, water, and salt.
steps: Moisten about a pound of flour with water, add salt, and do not put butter, making the dough soft
Let rest for half an hour and then extend with the rolling pin, so that it is a finger thick
Then spread fresh butter on it evenly, fold in two, and press with the rolling pin
Incorporate the butter and repeat the same operation four or five times
Then make the gâteau, gild it, and cook

description: Prepared with rabbit, tomatoes, and garlic.

Season well and pour this sauce over the rabbit legs and serve

title: Gazapo a la Borgoñona (Young Rabbit Burgundy Style)
description: Prepared with rabbits, garlic, and bay leaf.
steps: Divide young rabbits into pieces
Heat butter in a casserole and add the rabbit portions after cleaning away blood with a sponge or drying with clean cloth
Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg, garlic and bay leaf
Cover the casserole with the lid and much fire on top; a quarter hour is enough for the rabbit to be well cooked
Moisten with a spoonful of demi-glace sauce and a glass of white wine
Let the sauce reduce somewhat and add turned mushrooms
Bind with egg yolks, a bit of butter, parsley and lemon juice

title: Gazapo Relleno de Gazapo (Young Rabbit Stuffed with Young Rabbit)
description: Prepared with rabbits, ham, and potatoes.
steps: Lard one deboned rabbit with ham
Coarsely chop the other rabbit with an equal piece of ham
Season the chopped mixture with salt and diced potatoes
Stuff the whole rabbit with this mixture and close it
Wrap in clean, thin linen
Place in a pan lined with ham
Arrange around it pieces of carrot, small whole onions, parsley, thyme, peppercorns, salt, and equal parts wine and broth or water
Add the broken bones from the rabbits
Cover with ham slices on top
Cook over two gentle fires
When cooked, let cool and strain the broth, degreasing it well
Clarify with egg white
Let it thicken and pour into dishes to set completely
Cover the rabbit with this aspic, topped with ham slices

title: Gaznates Rellenos en Forma de Pasuelо (Filled Gaznates in Pastry Form)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, melted butter, and brandy.

ingredients.name: one and a half ounces ground sugar
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half ounces ground sugar

ingredients.name: one and a half ounces melted butter
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half ounces melted butter

ingredients.name: half small cup refined Spanish brandy
ingredients.sourceText: half small cup refined Spanish brandy

steps: Beat thirteen egg yolks until it hardens and the beaten becomes white

Incorporate with a small spatula one and a half ounces of ground sugar passed through a sieve, another ounce of melted butter, half a small cup of refined Spanish brandy and as much flour as can be moistened with the egg
Add a little salt and a little tequesquite powder, ensuring the mixture is not hard
After well incorporated, place on a table and give it a light kneading, adding more flour if the dough is still sticky
If it is soft, extend on flour powder with a rolling pin and cut the gaznates with a cutter of the desired size
Shape with appropriate iron or tin pincers, moisten the edges to be joined with egg white, making some in the common form

ingredients.name: Four calderas of curdled milk (pressed, drained, and ground)

ingredients.sourceText: One small bowl of melted and lukewarm butter

steps: Mix four calderas of pressed, drained, and ground curdled milk with two calderas of corn flour
Add twelve egg yolks or as many as needed to moisten the dough
Add sifted sugar
Dissolve a little salt and tequesquite in the melted butter
Add the butter mixture gradually as the dough absorbs it
Dust the dough with ground cinnamon and clove
Beat the dough until it reaches the proper consistency, which is known by dropping a small amount in water—it should rise immediately to the surface

Form the gorditas on corn husks
Place on tin sheets and bake in a well-tempered oven where bran immediately browns

title: Guajolote en Adobo (Turkey in Adobo)
description: Prepared with turkey, ham, and veal.

ingredients.name: One cuartillo of white wine or one layer of brandy
ingredients.sourceText: One cuartillo of white wine or one layer of brandy

steps: Pluck and empty an old turkey, and tuck its feet into the body
Turn it a few times over the coals
Cover with thick slices of well-seasoned ham and wrap in cloth, which is sewn
Place in a pot just right for its size with veal scraps, ham strips and a veal shank
Moisten with one cuartillo of white wine or one layer of brandy, broth, roots, onions, a bundle of parsley and fine herbs, salt, pepper, garlic, and bay leaf
Cook over slow fire and turn
Once cooked, strain the broth through a sieve and reduce it until it becomes aspic
Leave it to cool, spread it over the turkey, place on a platter over a napkin, garnished with green parsley
It can also be served hot, reducing part of the aspic to sauce

description: Prepared with almonds, turkey, and chiles.

title: Guaxolote (Piernas de) Acompañadas (Accompanied Turkey Legs)
description: Prepared with turkey, beef, and mushrooms.
steps: Place the legs in cold water to bleed, then blanch in boiling water with a small piece of beef cut into dice and a good portion of mushrooms
Knead everything together with grated ham, parsley, onion, basil and shallots, all chopped, salt, pepper and two egg yolks
Choose two raw, well-cleaned turkey legs and bone them completely, leaving only the extremity of the bone that joins them with the feet
Fill them with the forcemeat, sewing them closed so the filling does not escape
Cook over low heat, barded with ham, in a sauce made with a glass of white wine, the same amount of broth, a bouquet of parsley and onion and little salt
When cooked and the sauce well reduced, remove the fat, take off the ham strips and the bouquet
Add two spoonfuls of clear broth and a small piece of butter the size of a walnut, kneaded with a pinch of flour and a little parboiled, chopped parsley
Let the sauce thicken over the fire and pour over the turkey legs
Serve with a little lemon juice or a splash of vinegar

title: Guaxolote en Mole Oaxaqueño (Turkey in Oaxacan Mole)
description: Prepared with turkey, chile, and peppercorns.

ingredients.name: One hundred wide dried chile peppers
ingredients.sourceText: One hundred wide dried chile peppers

ingredients.name: Two small baskets of soaked tomatoes
ingredients.sourceText: Two small baskets of soaked tomatoes

steps: Kill the turkey the day before it is to be eaten, and devein and toast without burning one hundred wide chile peppers
Grind the chiles with one quarter ounce of cinnamon, eighteen cloves, twelve peppercorns, and what can be grasped with three fingers of toasted culantro
Cut the turkey into pieces, wash them, and place them in a suitable pot with one pound of lard, salt, and a little water to parboil
Once parboiled, add the ground chile and let it cook a little with it
Add the spices and a little water, and after three boils remove from heat and let it sit overnight in the open air
The next day, cook two small baskets of soaked tomatoes, grind them, and mix well with the mole
Return to heat and cook until the turkey is well done; if desired, add pork neck or jowl
Care should be taken to add water as it is consumed, so that in the end the mole is thick

Grind everything well, fry in lard, add the corresponding water and salt
Place the pieces of raw turkey fried into the sauce and let them boil until cooked

title: Guaxolote en Otro Mole Poblano (Turkey in Another Mole Poblano)
description: Prepared with turkey, chile, and sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: pasilla chile peppers (deveined)
ingredients.sourceText: One pound of pasilla chile peppers (deveined)

ingredients.name: mulato chile peppers (deveined)
ingredients.sourceText: One pound of mulato chile peppers (deveined)

ingredients.name: Wide and pasilla chile peppers (if mulato is not available)
ingredients.sourceText: Wide and pasilla chile peppers (if mulato is not available)

ingredients.name: An equal amount of sesame seeds
ingredients.sourceText: An equal amount of sesame seeds

ingredients.name: One small basket of cooked tomatoes
ingredients.sourceText: One small basket of cooked tomatoes

steps: Two days after killing the turkey, cut it into regular pieces

Devein one pound of pasilla and one pound of mulato chiles, or if mulato is unavailable, use one and a half pounds of wide and half a pound of pasilla, and toast them on a comal carefully so they do not burn
Toast one pot-full of chile seeds and an equal amount of sesame seeds, and grind them well
Fry the portions of raw turkey with pork knuckle and jowl pieces
When well fried, add everything ground, mixed with competent water and the appropriate salt, and let it boil
After it has boiled for some time, grind one small basket of cooked tomatoes and add them to the pot, covering the meat with hot water so it cooks

When the turkey is done, grind half an ounce of cinnamon, one quarter ounce of cloves, ten fine peppercorns, one handful of toasted cilantro, and a little anise, and if there is not enough lard, burn what is needed and add it
Let it boil until the mole has thickened well, then serve with toasted sesame seeds on top
If it is not desired to make it with pork jowl and knuckle, add more lard

Toast them in lard so they do not burn
Toast three or four handfuls of pumpkin seeds with shell on a comal and grind them well
Form a ball like chocolate and put it to cook in boiling water
Meanwhile grind the fried chile, fry it in lard after grinding
Dissolve the pumpkin seed ball in a little broth or hot water and fry it with the chile
Add the necessary water or broth of the cooked turkey and the turkey itself in portions
If desired, add cooked pork ribs
Grind a little bit of clove, toasted cilantro and cinnamon, add it and let it season
When it has thickened well, season with salt because if added before it will break

title: Guayabale (Havana-Style Guava Paste)
description: Prepared with guavas, sugar, and water.
steps: Take a few guavas, peel them, cut them in half and remove all the insides with a spoon
Rinse the shells in cold water and place the insides in a vessel
Once clean, weigh the shells; for four pounds of guava, clarify five pounds of white sugar
Take one pound of the four pounds of guava and cut it into pieces, then grind the remaining three pounds
First add to the syrup to cook, then grind; when it reaches medium point, strain the insides through a sieve, and add all the jelly that comes out with a small cup of virgin honey

When it is ready to set point, take a small guinea plantain, chop it into pieces and add it; the point should be such that when you insert the paddle, the bottom of the pot is uncovered so it cuts well
Remove from heat and add small amounts of half-crushed sugar, about half a pound, which is most proper, and add more sugar on top
Pour into boxes and place in the sun

title: Guayabate (Guava Confection)
description: A confection made with guavas, jelly, and sugar.
steps: The guava should be green and white in color; peel it, remove the seeds and grind it
Sieve and then weigh it; for each pound of fruit, use one pound of sugar, and for every four pounds of sugar, add half a cuartillo of tejocote jelly
Give the sugar a caramel point, mix it with the fruit and let it boil until you can see the bottom of the pot
In this state, beat with the greatest force possible until it turns white
Pour into small boxes, and after drying, to remove the paper, moisten the top, which also prevents them from crumbling

title: Guayabate Noyeliano (Noyau-Style Guava Confection)
description: A confection made with guavas, jelly, and egg whites.
steps: Peel the guavas and put them on the fire until they come to a boil; remove the insides and grind well
Pass the insides through a sieve or cloth and chop everything finely
Make a syrup at ball point with one and one-quarter pounds of sugar for each pound of guava
Once ready, add the paste with half a cuartillo of tejocote jelly for each pound of paste
Reach the point where a paddle moistens and enters; when it comes out clean, beat much until it cools, then add three egg whites beaten and strained for every five pounds of guava

title: Guayavate de la Habana sin Membrillo (Havana Guava Paste without Quince)
description: Prepared with guavas and sugar syrup.
steps: Choose ripe and not overly rotten guavas
Peel and halve them raw
Remove the hearts and wash immediately so no seeds or pits remain
Pass the hearts through a fine sieve so only the paste passes without any pits
Have prepared and clarified a syrup of regular consistency, neither too thin nor too thick, measuring equal amounts of syrup and guava
Add the halved guavas to the cold syrup, which is then placed over heat with them and brought to boil until very thick
Mix in what was passed through the sieve and begin to beat lengthwise

Continue beating until the guava paste reaches the proper point, which is known by taking a little with a small spoon and cooling it; if it hardens and separates from the arm when struck, it is a sign that it has reached the proper consistency

title: Güaxolote de Bodas (Wedding Turkey)
description: Prepared with fat, lamb or beef or sweetbreads, and lamb.
steps: Select the largest and fattest turkey available and empty it from the bottom.
After cleaning well, cut off the feet and neck, lowering the skin downward so that the excess remains and can cook, covering three fingers of neck.
Two days after slaughtering, prepare the following filling.
Cook the sweetbreads, tongues, kidneys and giblets, then cut them into equal dice pieces.
Add equal pieces of potato or chestnut, dust well with salt and pepper and roll in very fine breadcrumbs.
Fry in lard until perfectly golden, then set aside.
In another pan with lard, fry the chorizos, small chorizos, longaniza and morcón, also browning them in lard.
Remove them, empty the large chorizos and slice the longaniza into thin slices; halve the small chorizos.
Mix everything with the sweetbread mixture and place a clean pan on the fire with equal parts lard and oil.
Fry much sliced onion in it, then grind a lamb liver with a good handful of capers and parsley, frying everything in the lard.
Add salt, clove, cinnamon, a little vinegar and oil, with a handful of chopped mint.
Let it boil until it thickens, and just before removing from heat, add pitted raisins and set aside.
When it has cooled a little, mix all the fried, chopped meat into that broth.
If the gravy is somewhat dry, increase it with oil; but so that it does not become watery.
Sew the neck skin to the turkey, turn it over on it, and gradually fill it, adjusting the meat well in the hollows and pouring the broth equally.
When it is half filled, place some hard-boiled egg yolks inside.
When fully filled, sew the opening, taking care that it closes completely so no oil escapes.
Place the turkey in a large pot that covers it completely and add adequate salt, half a dozen whole onions, eight wide deveined chiles and three whole garlic heads.
Let it boil, taking care to turn it from time to time and adding boiling water if it reduces much, until it is cooked.
Let it reduce, and brown it in the remaining fat, increasing it if very little remains with cooking oil, until well browned, which can be achieved faster by placing a comal on top with some fire.
Once the turkey is browned, serve it with the following sauce.

Take a little of the fat in which the turkey was fried, and in a pan with it fry all the leftover gravy and filling, ground, with ten or twelve egg yolks, a cup of toasted pine nuts, finely chopped parsley and adequate salt.
When everything is well fried, add a little vinegar, and as soon as it has thickened enough, loosen the gravy with wine from Parras or Malaga and pour into the sauce boat.

After cleaning well, cut off the feet and neck, lowering the skin downward so that the excess remains and can cook, covering three fingers of neck.
Two days after slaughtering, prepare the following filling.
Cook the sweetbreads, tongues, kidneys and giblets, then cut them into equal dice pieces.
Add equal pieces of potato or chestnut, dust well with salt and pepper and roll in very fine breadcrumbs.
Fry in lard until perfectly golden, then set aside.
In another pan with lard, fry the chorizos, small chorizos, longaniza and morcón, also browning them in lard.
Remove them, empty the large chorizos and slice the longaniza into thin slices; halve the small chorizos.
Mix everything with the sweetbread mixture and place a clean pan on the fire with equal parts lard and oil.
Fry much sliced onion in it, then grind a lamb liver with a good handful of capers and parsley, frying everything in the lard.
Add salt, clove, cinnamon, a little vinegar and oil, with a handful of chopped mint.
Let it boil until it thickens, and just before removing from heat, add pitted raisins and set aside.
When it has cooled a little, mix all the fried, chopped meat into that broth.
If the gravy is somewhat dry, increase it with oil; but so that it does not become watery.
Sew the neck skin to the turkey, turn it over on it, and gradually fill it, adjusting the meat well in the hollows and pouring the broth equally.
When it is half filled, place some hard-boiled egg yolks inside.
When fully filled, sew the opening, taking care that it closes completely so no oil escapes.
Place the turkey in a large pot that covers it completely and add adequate salt, half a dozen whole onions, eight wide deveined chiles and three whole garlic heads.
Let it boil, taking care to turn it from time to time and adding boiling water if it reduces much, until it is cooked.
Let it reduce, and brown it in the remaining fat, increasing it if very little remains with cooking oil, until well browned, which can be achieved faster by placing a comal on top with some fire.
Once the turkey is browned, serve it with the following sauce.

Take a little of the fat in which the turkey was fried, and in a pan with it fry all the leftover gravy and filling, ground, with ten or twelve egg yolks, a cup of toasted pine nuts, finely chopped parsley and adequate salt.
When everything is well fried, add a little vinegar, and as soon as it has thickened enough, loosen the gravy with wine from Parras or Malaga and pour into the sauce boat.

description: Prepared with white sugar, oranges, and lemons.
steps: Dissolve twenty-two ounces of white sugar in two quartillos of clear water
Select eight or nine oranges and two lemons, clean them with a cloth
Scrape the rinds of the most fragrant and least bitter oranges
Cut them in half and squeeze them between thumb and forefinger with the other hand to break the small bladders where the juice is enclosed
Place between the palms of both hands, squeezing the rinds in opposite direction with force to break the cells that close the globules of essential oil that resides in the yellow rind
Strain the liquid through a fine-haired sieve and keep in a cool place

title: Helado de Rosas (Rose Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with cochineal, verjuice, and white sugar.

ingredients.name: one scruple of gum tragacanth, the whitest
ingredients.sourceText: one scruple of gum tragacanth, the whitest

ingredients.name: one and a half quartillos of water
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half quartillos of water

steps: Crush one drachm of cochineal and steep in infusion for twenty-four hours in half a quartillo of verjuice, keeping the vessel well covered and shaking the liquid every three hours
Prepare one scruple of the whitest gum tragacanth by crushing it in a marble mortar and moistening it from time to time with a little common water until it dissolves and forms a kind of mucilage
Pour twenty-two ounces of white sugar into one and a half quartillos of water, and when well dissolved, add the gum water and cochineal tincture, mixing everything and letting it sit for two hours
Strain the liquid through a cloth bag, add a little rose water, shake the mixture strongly and place in a cool place until you wish to freeze it

title: Hidromiel Vinoso (Vinous Mead)
description: Prepared with honey, brandy, and water.

ingredients.name: one and a half jars of spring or river water
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half jars of spring or river water

ingredients.name: four quartillos of the purest white honey
ingredients.sourceText: four quartillos of the purest white honey

steps: Bring the water and honey to a boil until an egg can float on the surface of the liquid, which indicates the liquid has acquired sufficient consistency to be preserved for a long time
Add one ounce of refined brandy
Fill the barrel or cask only to two-thirds of its capacity so that the liquid, becoming rarefied during fermentation, has enough space to expand
Cover the barrel with linen and paper, for fear it might burst from fermentation
Expose to the sun or place in heated stoves so that the liquid ferments more quickly and its elements are better disposed to enter into the new combinations that form the spirituous parts
Some may mix aromas before fermentation begins
Others may add juice of mulberries, prickly pear, and other fruits for different tastes and colors
Can be stored for ten or twelve years

Add half an ounce of salt, one egg (white and yolk), one good glass of water, and four ounces of oil
After moistening the dough, let it rest for two hours
Flatten it afterwards, making it very thin, using the rest of the oil, up to a total of one quartillo, adding it to the dough as it becomes absorbed into it
It is necessary that all of the oil be consumed
This dough is suitable for meatless puff pastries or for fish
